ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation STDIN+ Launcher - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated use of stdin to execute PowerShell Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: ((event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*powershell.*"))) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\$\\{input\\}.*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*noexit.*")) AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\ \\/r\\ .*")))
